summary: Groups the health and clinical record controllers and the analytics service into one module the app can load.
purpose: Tells the app which routes and services belong to the health feature.
why: Reason not stated in the code. This is the standard way the framework groups related features.
how: Lists the six controllers and the analytics service. The analytics service is also shared so other modules can use it.
inputs: None directly. It is read when the app starts.
outputs: A module the main app loads, which makes its routes available.
risks: If a controller is left out of this list, its routes silently disappear from the running app.
debug: If a health route returns not found, check that its controller is listed here and that the module is imported by the main app.
